scientific_integrity: The q-ary return kernel, renewal calculation, and three distribution limits are proved in RESULT.md; finite enumeration is supplementary. Binary antecedents and the arbitrary-alphabet path bijection are explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent letters, fixed finite q>=2; no nonuniform or growing-alphabet theorem. G_q(1) is implicit for q>=4. Prior random-walk local-time theory may contain equivalent forms and independent scientific validation remains outstanding.
title: An alphabet-size trichotomy for Abelian-border multiplicities
